title: 德國埃姆舍河整治
summary: 埃姆舍轉型先把污水從河道移入管網與處理系統，再改善河岸與棲地。學徒需檢查污水未分離時，單做景觀能否持續維持水質。
summaryEn: The Emscher transformation moves sewage from the river into sewers and treatment before restoring banks and habitat. Learners assess whether landscaping alone can sustain water quality without sewage separation.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 污水與雨水來源分類：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Sewage/stormwater source separation: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 污水與雨水來源分類：污染負荷與採樣邊界 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Sewage/stormwater source separation: Pollutant load and sampling boundary and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。本單元在「污水與雨水來源分類」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Examine this relationship at sewage/stormwater source separation.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：日流量 Q=1200 m³/d、流量加權濃度 C=180 mg/L。公式 L=QC/1000；代入 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d。適用邊界：採樣與流量必須涵蓋相同時窗；未包括管線內累積。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: daily flow Q=1200 m³/d and flow-weighted concentration C=180 mg/L. Formula L=QC/1000; substitution 1200*180/1000 = 216 kg/d. Boundary: Sampling and flow must cover the same time interval; accumulation in the sewer is omitted.
steps.failure: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「污水與雨水來源分類」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for sewage/stormwater source separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「污水與雨水來源分類」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the sewage/stormwater source separation measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「德國埃姆舍河整治」的「污水與雨水來源分類：污染負荷與採樣邊界：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「城市環境觀測任務」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Sewage/stormwater source separation: Pollutant load and sampling boundary: Mechanism and observation” in “Emscher River restoration”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban environmental observation mission” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
濃度較低就表示污染質量一定較少。
optionsEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Lower concentration necessarily means less pollutant mass.
quiz.explanation: 污染負荷是流量與濃度的乘積；瞬間低濃度可能只是雨水稀釋，不能單憑濃度推論污染總量下降。 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「污水與雨水來源分類」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
quiz.explanationEn: Pollutant load is flow times concentration; a low concentration can result from rainwater dilution without a decrease in mass. Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for sewage/stormwater source separation; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.checkEn: Compare level, flow and clear area, then inspect nonuniformity with multiple section measurements. Build an offline evidence table for new sewer-trunk section; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

steps.check: 比較水位、流量與有效面積，再以斷面多點量測查偏流。在離線場景為「新污水幹管斷面」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Compare level, flow and clear area, then inspect nonuniformity with multiple section measurements. Build an offline evidence table for new sewer-trunk section; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 新污水幹管斷面：流速與通水斷面
knowledge.titleEn: New sewer-trunk section: Velocity and flow area
knowledge.text: 只使用名目斷面會忽略攔污物或沉積造成的縮減。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
knowledge.textEn: Nominal area misses reductions caused by debris or sediment. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「新污水幹管斷面」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效面積減至0.45 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 m/s。與基準 1.5 m/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the new sewer-trunk section measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only clear area to0.45 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 m/s. Compare with baseline 1.5 m/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

quiz.question: 哪一項正確描述本步應診斷的失效原因？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement correctly describes the failure to diagnose?
options: 看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
阻塞不會改變同一流量下的流速。
只使用名目斷面會忽略攔污物或沉積造成的縮減。
optionsEn: An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Blockage cannot change velocity at the same flow.
Nominal area misses reductions caused by debris or sediment.
